subject: Election of 2021 Council Leadership
overview: The City Council elected its leadership for the 2021 calendar year and addressed municipal matters including 40B litigation costs, public transit station renaming, and cleaning service contracts.

items.title: Election of Council President
items.summary: Elected Richard Caraviello as Council President for the 2021 calendar year.

items.title: Election of Council Vice President
items.summary: Elected Adam Knight as Council Vice President for the 2021 calendar year.

items.title: Adoption of Standing Rules and Paper Transfer
items.summary: Adopted the standing committee rules and transferred all pending papers and committees from the 2020 session to the 2021 session.

items.title: Public Hearing: Stevens Automotive Transfer
items.summary: Approved a Class II motor vehicle sales license for 60 Union Street to allow the petitioner to dispose of abandoned vehicles more efficiently.

items.title: GLX Ball Square Station Renaming
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the MBTA rename the Ball Square station to 'Ball Square South Medford Station' to reflect its location and improve wayfinding.

items.title: Christmas Tree Pickup and Memorial Dedication
items.summary: Approved a one-week extension for Christmas tree collection and dedicated the meeting to the memory of former Governor's Councilor Michael J. Callahan.

items.title: Mystic Avenue Infrastructure
items.summary: Approved requesting MassDOT return in the spring to repaint and re-stripe crosswalks and other areas on Mystic Avenue where new paint is already wearing off.

items.title: 40B Development Litigation and Costs
items.summary: Approved requesting a status update and detailed breakdown of legal costs for three 40B developments currently on appeal. The matter was referred to a Committee of the Whole to discuss strategies for protecting neighborhoods.

items.title: Police Station Cleaning Procurement
items.summary: Approved a request for an update on custodial services for the new police station; the administration reported that a vendor was secured, and the Council requested a copy of the RFP.

items.title: Federal Relief Bill Impact
items.summary: Approved requesting an update on how the recently passed federal relief bill will impact city finances and rental assistance funding.

items.title: Condolences and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved condolences for the family of Peter Brady, accepted a committee report regarding a zoning consultant contract defect, and approved the minutes of December 15 while tabling the minutes of December 22.
